nonblocking_findings.finding: The present source is NOT safe to enter CPL3. Its missing seal, USER transaction, verified exception ABI, user descriptors/TSS and privileged/emergency stacks are correctly identified as mandatory future gates rather than existing results.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Retained structures do not seal active mappings or retain arbitrary CPU/TSS stack backing. A one-shot owner must actually dominate every reachable privileged mutation/release path; retaining leases alone is insufficient.
nonblocking_findings.disposition: F1 bypass audit and F4 sealed owner are mandatory. No blanket audit approval of bootstrap or all crate-private numeric callers is given.

criteria.unclosed_memory_safety_prerequisites: Adequately identified and gated, not closed: sealed no-mutation lifecycle, effective active-map supervisor audit, narrow owned USER publication, backing accessibility, stable privileged entry resources and bounded failure retention. No omitted prerequisite requiring rejection of the conditional proposal was identified within this bounded inspection.
criteria.allocate_map_unmap_release_authority: Inspected actual ordinary boundaries: allocate_owned issues stamped move-only identity (frame.rs:378-418); owns_live_lease authenticates allocator/domain/id/live state (425-437); release_frame consumes lease and authenticates before pin-protected release (508-525,457-463); map_owned checks lease/domain then private supervisor-only admission, accessibility, pins-before-PTE (paging.rs:310-321,373-475); unmap_owned checks live identity then exact payload and clear/invalidate/unpin (484-494,568-579). Numeric adapters are cfg(test), private cores are not general safe process APIs. Refusal diagnostics may change: nonmutation means authority/backing/capacity, not all counters.
criteria.deferred_teardown: Genuinely deferrable for exactly one existing-CR3 payload per boot with bounded monotonically retained acquisitions and no reachable cleanup, retry, ownership transfer, CR3 switch or resumed shell. Terminal Ring-0 halt is a nonreturning privilege entry, not recovery. Any later recoverable continuation invalidates this simplification and requires a new lifetime design.
criteria.active_cr3_tables_stacks: Inspected retain before publication in memory/mod.rs:228-232 and before both CR3-writing helpers in paging.rs:691-701 and 898-918. This protects the unpublished cleanup set, not arbitrary payload/stack unmapping. F1/F4 must additionally retain immutable metadata, tables, all CPU/TSS stacks, GDT/IDT/TSS and payloads through terminal observation and external termination.
criteria.error_no_error_and_origin: Current opaque 48-byte no-error frame and packed error-first structures are insufficient independent ABI evidence. F2 correctly requires normalization and trusted saved-CS origin plus known payload PC, not PF user bit alone. QEMU must validate true error/no-error frames and wrong-origin failure.
criteria.ss_esp_gpr_segments_alignment_df: Explicitly covered as future requirements: origin-dependent old SS/ESP decoding, actual TSS switch, GPR evidence before Rust clobbers, trusted segment reload before Rust memory access, restoration on returning paths, preserved original frame across alignment, CLD before Rust and hostile STD/segment fixtures. These are neither verified by host structs nor presently implemented guarantees.
criteria.iret_tss_double_fault: F2/F3/F5 correctly require reviewed nonreturning IRETD construction and flags/selectors, retained 32-bit TSS and loaded TR, SS0/ESP0, I/O denial, guard/headroom and emergency containment. CLI is explicitly not an NMI/double-fault solution. Current ordinary vector-8 error handler supplies no emergency stack guarantee; real bad-transition/overflow/DF negative evidence and no-reset observation remain mandatory.
criteria.vectors_21_29_30: Correctly left architecture-dependent, requiring an exact vendor/CPU/features model and independent reference to prove unreachable or install correct shapes. No endorsement of source comments naming an Intel volume/table or the self-matching host classifier as authoritative validation.
criteria.user_permissions_and_isolation: Proposed existing-CR3 arena is acceptable only with absent/conflict checks, valid exclusively owned zeroed backing, effective PDE and PTE rights, supervisor identity aliases and no kernel-directory elevation. Current ordinary API must stay supervisor-only. Non-PAE NX absence is disclosed; no W^X guarantee. The dedicated supervisor sentinel avoids deliberately corrupting live kernel data. Expected #PF needs exact PC/CR2/error/origin/stack/flags/register validation and unchanged sentinel; denial is not proven by text markers alone.
criteria.retained_cap_policy: Acceptable conditional cap policy: one fixed manifest, one attempt latched before acquisition, bounded per-stage failure retention and no searching/retry queue. Existing retention and incremental acquisitions must be separate. Unknown byte counts/headroom are explicitly stop gates, not an unmeasured leak justified by reboot.
criteria.smoke_evidence: Positive ELF/GRUB ISO by 128/512 MiB fresh-boot matrix plus negative code-write/guard/invalid-entry/wrong-origin/STD/segment/DF fixtures is appropriate. Exact fixture, CPU, prepared resource and terminal identities; missing/extra markers, reset/triple fault, timeout or shell resumption must fail. Owned QEMU termination is distinct from terminal in-guest halt. None was run in this review.
criteria.pointer_consistency: Read top pointer additions and full Git diffs for all three pointer documents. They defer to the conditional A-F design, deny execution/complete closure and require separate F1 authorization. Historical sections remain historical, not new approval.

roadmap_recommendation.rationale: General published/inactive teardown, per-map transfer, shared/COW, repeated launch, recoverable shell continuation, ELF/syscalls/scheduling and SMP do not enable this terminal single-map smoke and add unnecessary mechanisms. Do not reopen accepted authority checkpoints absent a reproduced regression. No further slice elimination is supported: merging labels does not remove the independent lifetime, ABI, hardware stack, USER publication or guest-proof obligations.
roadmap_recommendation.six_slice_limit: Five is a conditional safe planning envelope, not a guaranteed implementation estimate. If authoritative F2/F3 or seal design cannot remain bounded within six independently implementable slices, stop and report that incompatibility rather than conceal context switching or waive containment.
